searchText: MSRP $41,590. 2026 Forest River Aurora 23BHS is approximately 28' 4' in length with 1 slide. Features Outside Kitchen Aurora Base Package Aurora Comfort and Construction Package GE Kitchen Suite & Appliance Package More About This RV This RV features the solid entry steps, front radius lights, multi-color power awning with remote, siphon 360 Roof vent, HDMI & USB, smooth metal radius front, magnetic baggage door latches and LCI ladder prep. Additional package on this RV is the Aurora Comfort and Construction package that includes screwed cabinet construction, 5/8' tongue and groove floor, friction hinge, entry door, ABS tub/shower surround, black tank flush, 12V power vent fan in bathroom, LED interior lights, Norco electromagnetic and powder coated frame, back up camera prep & battery disconnect. This Aurora includes the GE Kitchen Suite and appliance package which includes the upgraded 13.5K GE AC with heat pump, GE 60K BTU tankless water heater, 12V 10 Cu. FT. GE refrigerator, stainless GE Microwave, Stainless GE range with range vent & drop edge thermofoil countertops and much more.
